mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM storage_orphan WHERE reason = #{reason} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT storage_orphan_id AS storageOrphanId, file_key AS fileKey, reason AS reason, retry_count AS retryCount FROM storage_orphan WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY enqueued_at, storage_orphan_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE storage_orphan SET retry_count = retry_count + 1, last_error = #{lastError}, status = CASE WHEN retry_count + 1 > #{maxRetry} THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'PENDING' END, needs_review = CASE WHEN retry_count + 1 > #{maxRetry} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHERE storage_orphan_id = #{id}
